meta_description: Plastic and Plumbing in Stoke-on-Trent. Your local plumbers' merchant supplying pipes, fittings, and heating parts. Visit us in Burslem today.
hero_subhead: Stock the pipes, fittings, and heating parts you need, fast. Expert advice on hand, every time.
services_heading: Complete Plumbing & Heating Supplies for Stoke-on-Trent
services_subhead: From copper and plastic pipe to boiler parts and tools, we stock everything a plumber or heating engineer needs.

services.title: Copper & Plastic Pipe
services.desc: Full range of copper tube and plastic pipe in all sizes. Cut to length and pressure-tested in-house. Stock from 10mm to 42mm.

services.title: Plumbing Fittings & Valves
services.desc: Compression fittings, push-fit connectors, and isolation valves. Top brands held in stock; specialist items ordered same day.

services.title: Boiler & Heating Parts
services.desc: Replacement parts for Worcester, Baxi, Ideal, and Vaillant. Circulating pumps, thermostats, and controls always available.

services.title: Central Heating Systems
services.desc: Complete radiators, thermostatic radiator valves, and manifolds. Expert guidance on system design and upgrades.

services.title: Water Tanks & Cylinders
services.desc: Hot water cylinders, cold water tanks, and expansion vessels. Storage and combination tank options in stock.

services.title: Plumbing Tools & Equipment
services.desc: Pipe benders, cutters, wrenches, and test equipment. Hire options available for larger jobs and one-off projects.

about_pullquote: We've built this on trust—supply what plumbers actually need, at fair prices, with real help.
about_para_1: Plastic and Plumbing has been Stoke-on-Trent's go-to independent plumbers' merchant for nearly two decades. We started because local tradespeople needed a supplier they could rely on—someone who kept stock, answered the phone, and understood the job. From a single counter in Burslem, we've grown to serve hundreds of plumbers and heating engineers across the city and beyond.
about_para_2: We're proud to stock the brands tradespeople trust: Worcester, Baxi, Ideal, and Vaillant heating parts sit alongside the copper, plastic, fittings, and tools you need to finish the job right. Our team lives and works locally—we understand Stoke, we understand the trades, and we're here when you need us.
reviews_heading: What Stoke-on-Trent Plumbers Say About Us

reviews.text: Best merchant in the city. Always have what you need in stock, and if they don't, it's there by next morning. The lads behind the counter know their stuff—saves me hours on the phone chasing suppliers.
reviews.author: Dave K.

reviews.text: Switched to Plastic and Plumbing five years ago and never looked back. Fair prices, friendly service, and they'll always talk you through a tricky job. That's worth more than the big chains.
reviews.author: Mark T.

reviews.text: Popped in needing a replacement pump for a Worcester boiler, didn't know the exact part. Chap working there identified it straight away and had it fitted in my van within ten minutes. Excellent.
reviews.author: Colin W.
